rationale: BLOCKED. I read the complete held EO 13678 (79 FR 60949, Oct. 3, 2014): sec. 1 finds an exception to competitive examination is warranted and lets ATF criminal investigators appointed under Schedule B who completed 3 years of satisfactory service be converted non-competitively to career appointments under OPM-set qualifications; sec. 2 directs OPM to issue implementing regulations; sec. 3 is the general-provisions disclaimer. It has no own-term sunset, expiry or trigger and no savings clause. The only history observation is an empty catalog note. No acting instrument is held, and nothing in the held record shows a current OPM regulation or later order touching it. A continuing hiring authority of this kind is plausibly still operative, but a YES requires a held CURRENT: record checked through 2026-10-14 and none exists; a NO has no ending instrument. Both statuses unsupported.
